title: First jobs: St. Elizabeth Hall, Millenburg and Happy Landing
summary: His first job was at St. Elizabeth Hall, and he later played Happy Landing for years with Georgie Parker's band.

story.theme_name: Dance halls, lake camps and riverboat bandstands
story.community_name: Dance halls, lake resorts and where bands played

blocks.x: Well we played at some place up there, I think it was the, it's called St. Elizabeth Hall. Yeah, St. Elizabeth Hall, I think that was on Camp Street, Camp Valance. Uptown.
That was the first job I played.
You played like weekend or Saturday night dances all the time?
Yeah, we played there I think three nights, three nights a week, Friday, Saturday and Sunday. Yeah.
Any other places ever played like out of Millenburg or Picnic?
Yes, I played a lot. I played Millenburg, I played Happy Landing, I played there for years, Happy Landing.
Who did you work there with?

Well I worked there with Georgie Parker, Happy Landing. I worked there about four or five years straight. Who else was in the band? Yeah, they had, let's see, Elmer Talbot was on trumpet and what you call him was on banjo was, well we call him Father Calley. He played, he played Father Calley. Father Calley, he played Father Calley we called him. He played guitar. And let's see, who was on the trombone, we have a trombone, yeah we have a trombone. Let's see who that was.
